question: Has California Cold-Pressed Avocado Oil been acquired by or merged with another company? Who owns California Cold-Pressed Avocado Oil now?
markdown:
"California cold-pressed avocado oil" typically refers to independent estate producers like
⁠Bella Vado
(founded by the da Silva family in San Diego County) rather than a single corporate brand.
There are no public records or announcements indicating that Bella Vado or boutique California cold-pressed avocado oil producers have been acquired or merged; they remain family-owned and operated
